names: the rotation is an act of the fire

entities.name: keeper.md
entities.description: Standard work document for the weekly fire ritual, written at Henri's ask to fix the task rather than the person.

entities.name: Henri
entities.description: The author and keeper who performs this weekly ritual, expressed doubt about being up for the task.

entities.name: vision.md
entities.description: A capped method document stating the tree 'won't demand your presence,' cited to show the ritual must never become a demand.

entities.name: spec/rules.md
entities.description: One of the five capped method documents that a session reads before it knows what it is working on; contains the rotation and archive contracts.

entities.name: test/gates.md
entities.description: The page produced by the gates check, showing the Rules and Journal lamp rows.

entities.name: tools/suite.py
entities.description: Script run with --gates to perform twelve structural checks in about fourteen seconds, producing test/gates.md.

entities.name: tools/rulecount.py
entities.description: Pull-version tool showing how many lines the five rule documents use against the 2,000-line cap.

entities.name: tools/journalroll.py
entities.description: Tool used to check the journal budget and, with --roll --themes, to close and rotate the journal file.

entities.name: tools/sittings.py
entities.description: Tool run with --days 7 to measure the sitting limit against the week that happened, including how often sitting resumed after a limit was reached.

entities.name: tools/gapcheck.py
entities.description: Tool reading the same ledger as sittings.py for the other open number, the 30-minute silence nobody chose.

entities.name: tools/pages.sh
entities.description: Script that generates and pushes the music pages to the gh-pages branch, reporting 'nothing to commit' when already current.

entities.name: board/later/
entities.description: The pile of cards reviewed in act 4, each asked whether it waits on an event (sediment) or on the keeper (debt).

entities.name: board/done/
entities.description: Record of finished cards cited as evidence the allegedly too-hard parts are already being done, with dates.

entities.name: doc/memory/
entities.description: Memory record directory cited alongside board/done/ and the journal as evidence of completed hard work.

entities.name: doc/memory/decisions-arrive-shaped.md
entities.description: The contract sessions are held to for how decision cards must arrive shaped, with question, options, default, trigger, reversibility, and recommendation.

entities.name: card:memory-atrophy.md
entities.description: Card referenced for the closed-book-first move in measuring a rule, dated 2026-08-24 as move 1.

entities.name: card:online.md
entities.description: Card for the music pages site, a tab for every piece in examples/audio/, kept fresh by tools/pages.sh.

entities.name: examples/audio/
entities.description: Directory of music pieces, each rendered as a playable tab on the pushed pages.

entities.name: gh-pages branch
entities.description: The branch hosting the music pages, updated by tools/pages.sh.

entities.name: spec/author.md
entities.description: Document establishing that editing the five method documents (step 2 of journal rotation) is the author's role, not delegable.

entities.name: Toyota
entities.description: Referenced as the source of 'standard work,' writing procedures so the job could be done on a tired Tuesday rather than requiring heroic operators.

entities.name: andon
entities.description: Referenced analogy for batching questions together rather than answering them one at a time, as the decisions batch does.

entities.name: Journal lamp
entities.description: One of the two gate rows, measuring the open month's journal against its budget; when lit, signals the rotation act is due.

entities.name: Rules lamp
entities.description: One of the two gate rows, measuring the five method documents against the 2,000-line cap.

entities.name: decisions batch (act 2)
entities.description: The weekly act of opening all cards blocked on a decision together, approving defaults rather than composing fresh answers.

entities.name: Read the lamps (act 1)
entities.description: First act of the cadence: running the gates check once per fire, about one minute.

entities.name: Measure one rule (act 3)
entities.description: Third act: picking one rule per fire and testing, closed-book first, whether it decided anything in the week that happened.

entities.name: One pass over the pile (act 4)
entities.description: Fourth act: reviewing board/later/ to sort cards into sediment (waiting on an event) or debt (waiting on the keeper).

entities.name: Rotate the journal (act 5)
entities.description: Fifth act, done about monthly when the Journal lamp says so: skim, promote, index, and close the journal file.

entities.name: Push the pieces (act 6)
entities.description: Sixth act, done now and then when a piece changes: running tools/pages.sh to update the music pages.

entities.name: sitting limit
entities.description: The rule set on 2026-08-21 governing sitting duration, measured weekly by tools/sittings.py against actual behavior.

entities.name: "Archive, don't airbrush"
entities.description: Section of spec/rules.md stating nothing in the journal is rewritten, since git already remembers and retroactive editing would create a second source of truth.

entities.name: "The rotation is an act of the fire"
entities.description: Section of spec/rules.md giving the full contract for the four-step journal rotation act.
Date keeper.md was written, at Henri's ask, and the date the sitting limit was set.
Date attached to card:memory-atrophy.md move 1, the closed-book-first technique.
Date of Henri's own pick/quote about not needing the site to always be fresh.

relations.description: Henri asked for this document to be written and is the sole reader/performer of the ritual it describes.
keeper.md invokes vision.md's promise that the tree won't demand presence, to ensure the ritual cannot become a demand.
keeper.md distinguishes itself from the five capped documents including spec/rules.md, which sessions read before work.
Act 1 is performed by running tools/suite.py --gates.
Running tools/suite.py --gates produces the test/gates.md page with two lamp rows.
test/gates.md contains the Rules lamp row measuring the five method documents against 2,000 lines.
test/gates.md contains the Journal lamp row measuring the open month against its budget.
tools/rulecount.py is the pull version of the Rules lamp, showing exact line counts.
tools/journalroll.py is the pull version of the Journal lamp and also performs the rotation.
Act 2 holds cards to the contract defined in decisions-arrive-shaped.md, so each arrives already shaped.
Batching decision questions together is likened to how the andon batches its questions.
The closed-book-first move in act 3 is documented as move 1 in card:memory-atrophy.md.
If a rule is found to be fat or wrong, tools/rulecount.py shows how many lines are left in the cap.
The sitting limit rule already has its meter in tools/sittings.py, making it the cheapest rule to measure weekly.
tools/sittings.py measures the sitting limit set on 2026-08-21 against the actual week's sittings.
tools/gapcheck.py reads the same ledger as tools/sittings.py for a different open number, the 30-minute silence.
The sitting limit was set by Henri on 2026-08-21.
Act 4 is a pass over board/later/, sorting each card into sediment or debt.
Debt cards found in act 4 are moved into next fire's act 2 (the decisions batch).
The full contract for act 5 is given in spec/rules.md's section 'The rotation is an act of the fire.'

relations.target: "The rotation is an act of the fire"
relations.description: Act 5's four steps are defined by this section of spec/rules.md.
The rule against rewriting the journal during rotation is grounded in this section of spec/rules.md.
Step 4 of act 5 closes the file by running tools/journalroll.py --roll --themes.
Step 2 of the rotation, promoting lines into the method files, is reserved to the author per spec/author.md.
Act 6 is performed by running tools/pages.sh.
tools/pages.sh keeps the music pages fresh, including card:online.md.
tools/pages.sh generates a tab for every piece in examples/audio/ and pushes to gh-pages.
tools/pages.sh generates and commits the music pages to the gh-pages branch.
Henri's own pick on 2026-08-29 established that the site need not always be fresh, shaping act 6's cadence.
keeper.md invokes Toyota's philosophy of standard work to justify fixing the task rather than the person.
keeper.md points to board/done/ as evidence, with dates, that the allegedly too-hard parts are already being done.
keeper.md points to doc/memory/ alongside board/done/ as a record of completed hard work.
keeper.md was written on 2026-08-21 at Henri's ask.
card:memory-atrophy.md's move 1 is dated 2026-08-24.
